suites.label: 1 Bedroom
suites.description:
A one bedroom with an open living and kitchen area, tall windows. Room to settle in, a short walk from the beach and King Street.

CAEEDAR is a new geothermal rental building at 325 University Ave W in downtown Cobourg, an hour east of Toronto. Victoria Park Beach, the harbour and the shops on King Street are a short walk away.
